versions.changelog:
Initial release – comprehensive enterprise cybersecurity assessment and hardening toolkit (Free Edition).

- 12-phase security assessment methodology, from situational evaluation to scoring system.
- STRIDE+ threat modeling with risk prioritization matrix (P0-P3).
- OWASP Top 10 (A01–A10) application security audit checklist.
- Infrastructure hardening: security baselines, container security, and cloud security checks.
- Results output in Markdown, including status, summary, data, and error handling.
- Supports Windows, macOS, Linux; requires LLM API key configuration.
